draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base extends to the held-out customer-service domains evaluated (Insurance, Telecom and Utilities), where it achieves higher macro-F1 in each case.
rationale: T1.r3-r5 show Wrenfold beats Fennick-Base on all three held-out domains (85.7/81.2, 83.9/80.4, 86.2/82.0). The sentence hedges with "may extend," but the evidence directly shows the advantage does extend to these domains. No statistical test is reported, so significance language must be avoided, but the observed advantage is directly supported.
